entities.summary: Syed Mokhtar Al-Bukhary (b. 1951-12-12, Alor Setar) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Alor Setar and Malaysia. Known in the fields of malaysia, merchants & economists, asia.
